The company must make a Change of Control Offer to the holders after a change of control. [Section 4.10] 

This Change of Control Offer may be made in advance of the Change of Control and conditioned upon such Change of Control if a definitive agreement is in place for the Change of Control at the time of making the offer. [Section 4.10]

On the Change of Control Payment Date, the company will, to the extent lawful: (i) accept for payment all Notes or portions of Notes properly tendered pursuant to the Change of Control Offer; (ii) deposit with the paying agent an amount equal to the Change of Control Payment in respect of all Notes or portions of Notes properly tendered; and (iii) deliver or cause to be delivered to the Trustee the Notes properly accepted together with an Officers' Certificate. [Section 4.10]

The company will comply with the requirements of Rule 14e-1 under the Exchange Act and any other applicable securities laws and regulations in connection with the repurchase of the Notes as a result of a Change of Control. [Section 4.10]

Additionally, the company will send a notice (which may be conditional) to each Holder regarding the Change of Control Offer at the earlier of the public announcement of a Change of Control or the company's intention to effect a Change of Control or Change of Control Triggering Event. [Section 12.14]

The Holder of a Note may elect to have the Note or a portion thereof purchased by completing the form entitled "Option of Holder to Elect Purchase" and tendering the Note pursuant to the Change of Control Offer. [Section 12.14]

Any Note (or portion thereof) accepted for payment and for which payment has been duly provided on the Change of Control Payment Date shall cease to accrue interest after that date. [Section 12.14]
